name: StdRankingBot
description: Enterprise Gamification & Chat Ranking Telegram Bot built in Go. HD Leaderboard Banners (Daily/Weekly/Monthly), XP & Level Progression, Profile Cards, and Anti-Farming.

OWNER_ID.description: Telegram Numeric User ID of the Bot Owner

FORCE_SUB_CHANNEL.description: Channel username to force users to join before accessing private features (without @)

LOG_CHANNEL_ID.description: Channel ID for audit logs (optional, e.g. -1001234567890)

ANTI_SPAM_COOLDOWN_SECONDS.description: Cooldown between counting messages per user in seconds (Anti-Farming, default: 3)
